tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use this when a seller wants to find a print-on-demand (POD) product to compare across suppliers such as Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, CustomCat, Fourthwall and Inkthreadable. Search by product type such as T-shirt, hoodie or mug, or by brand and model such as Bella+Canvas 3001 or Gildan 5000

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use this to browse POD Benchmark's product categories, with product counts and starting delivered prices for a destination. Pass a category id to search_products to list its products.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this when a seller asks about a product's specs, fabric, fit, print methods or what is similar to it. Returns curated product facts and similar products with what they share and how they differ. Specs describe the product; they do not promise every supplier offers every option.

tools.name: get_product_options
tools.description: Use this when a seller wants supplier pricing for a specific print-on-demand product size or color, such as an adult M black T-shirt or an 11 oz mug. Lists the product's fields and supported configurations for the destination and currency; narrow with words or choices. Pass a returned key as optionK

tools.name: compare_product
tools.description: Use this when a seller asks which print-on-demand (POD) supplier costs less for a product, wants a Printify vs Printful product comparison, or needs to compare product prices, shipping costs, delivered totals or estimated delivery times. Compares Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, CustomCat, Fourt

tools.name: resolve_supplier_link
tools.description: Use this when a seller pastes a supplier product link (Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, CustomCat, Fourthwall or Inkthreadable). Returns the matching POD Benchmark product and any colour the link selects, ready for compare_product with yourSupplier set to that supplier. It never opens the link.

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: Use this to list the print-on-demand suppliers POD Benchmark compares, with their type and website.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Use this when a seller asks how a supplier works: plans and monthly fees, custom branding, who handles checkout, support and refunds, where it prints, or which print providers a marketplace uses. tools.name: get_supplier_prices
tools.description: Use this when a seller asks how a supplier's prices compare overall, by category, or against one other supplier: how many products it is the cheapest for, where it costs more, and by how much. tools.name: supplier_guide
tools.description: Use this when a seller is choosing a supplier for a product type (t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, wall art, stickers or phone cases) and their shop: where buyers are, the platform, whether they need custom branding, want to start free, or want to choose their print provider. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compare_product" is 2571 chars, far longer than this server's median (330). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
